<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Advisory Client Matters</subject>
<body>
I spoke with each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this matter was deferred due to more urgent priorities. However, you all agreed that a fixed cut-off for submitting client instructions would be appropriate for our London, New York and Toronto offices.

The best approach is to set the cut-off at 4pm daily (to give some context on volume, I reviewed yesterday’s activity to see how many matters were instructed after 4pm London time. There were three new Corporate mandates and two Compliance engagements). After 4pm, any new instructions would automatically be scheduled for the next business day. That said, for those matters submitted just before the cut-off, the relevant advisory teams will need to recognise that these will be recorded as the following day’s workload. 

I’m unsure how this will impact the case management system at Meridian, particularly for the daily position reports, as the official logs won’t include these late instructions. Could the IT team generate supplementary reports to ensure that the advisory units have accurate visibility each morning?

I would welcome any feedback, and in any case, please confirm that the 4pm cut-off works for your respective teams.

Danielle  
x36557

Eric – any issues anticipated with the Compliance reporting?  
Mary – we touched on this briefly recently… any further thoughts?  
</body>
